svg.title: Жим Арнольда — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Standing Arnold press from three-quarter front view. LEFT phase: hold two separate dumbbells directly in front of lower face, parallel upper arms pointing FORWARD from shoulders, elbows tucked and close together in front of chest, vertical forearms, palms facing toward own face (backs of knuckles toward viewer), dumbbells at about chin level. The two elbows stay inside shoulder width and are not flared. RIGHT phase: both dumbbells fully overhead, elbows nearly straight, palms have rotated to face forward (fingers/grip facing viewer). Keep the same feet and athletic posture. Make the two different grips clear and never draw the ordinary wide goalpost lower pose. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
